text:
anya: Quick EOD sync — planning to push the routing-rules v2 change at 18:00 PT today. Need a hotseat owner, rollback owner, and someone to run the smoke checklist. @ops-team please ack if you can cover.

ben: I can take hotseat 18:00-19:00. Will stay by my laptop. :thumbsup:

lee: I'll be rollback owner — familiar with the script in `infra/tools/rollback.sh`. If anything goes sideways I can flip traffic back to v1.

anya: Awesome, thanks. Sophie — can you run the smoke after the push? It's small but has a prefix cache tweak.

sophie: Yep, I'll run smoke and basic latency checks. Do we want me to confirm the KV prefix hit-rate?

anya: Yes please — focus on: 1) 200 OKs on /health and /api/generate, 2) KV hit-rate not below 85%, 3) p95 latency under 350ms. If any fail, call rollback.

ops-bot: Reminder — deploy window begins in 45 minutes. Posting canary target: `us-west-2a` then expand.

ben: Can we do a guarded canary? One instance, 5% traffic for 10m then 50% for 5m then full. I want to monitor error-rate and 5xx spikes.

lee: Agreed. I'll watch metrics and be ready to run `infra/tools/rollback.sh --to v1.9.2` if error rate > 1% sustained for 2 min.

anya: Plan below (copy to your runbooks):
```
- Start canary at 18:00 PT (us-west-2a) 5% traffic
- Wait 10m -> check errors, KV hit-rate, p95
- If good -> increase to 50% for 5m
- Final -> 100% rollforward
- If failure condition -> rollback to v1.9.2, notify #incidents and paging
```

sophie: I'll post results in this thread. Also will capture flamegraphs if latency creeps.

ben: Quick pre-checks I ran: deploy artifact checksum matches, smoke-runner local passes, infra quota OK for the canary instance. :white_check_mark:

anya: Perfect. One more ask — if you see cold-start errors after the canary, tag `@maria` (she owns image build) so we can triage rapidly.

lee: Noted. I'll keep a checklist open and ping here at each stage.

anya: Thanks team — I'll kick off at 18:00. If nobody objects, consider this the plan.

ben: No objections from me.

sophie: All good. Going to stage my smoke scripts now.

ops-bot: Deploy started at 18:00 PT by anya. Canary routing applied to us-west-2a (5%).
